Definition: from G5452; trans-planting, i.e. (concretely) a shrub or vegetable:--plant.
BiblicalUsage: Phyteia is a plant, something set in the ground. Jesus uses it once, in Matthew 15:13: every plant which my heavenly Father has not planted shall be rooted up.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that only what God plants lasts, and everything else is pulled up in the end.
